arguments.sql:
SELECT 'TG' AS field, typeof(l.TG) AS storage_type,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count,
       MIN(l.TG) AS min_value, MAX(l.TG) AS max_value
FROM main.Laboratory AS l
GROUP BY typeof(l.TG)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Birthday', typeof(p.Birthday),
       COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
       MIN(p.Birthday), MAX(p.Birthday)
FROM main.Patient AS p
JOIN main.Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
GROUP BY typeof(p.Birthday),
         p.Birthday IS NOT NULL AND p.Birthday IS date(p.Birthday);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_lab_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS qualifying_lab_patients,
       COUNT(p.ID) AS matched_lab_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
           WHEN p.Birthday > date('2026-10-09', '-51 years')
            AND p.Birthday < date('2026-10-09', '-50 years') THEN p.ID
       END) AS patients_between_birthdate_cutoffs,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
           WHEN p.Birthday = date('2026-10-09', '-50 years') THEN p.ID
       END) AS patients_on_50th_birthday
FROM main.Laboratory AS l
LEFT JOIN main.Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200;
